description: Correct control: compare the V. cholerae K00836 gene with the two KT2440 K00836 genes to test for a hidden fused diaminobutyrate decarboxylase
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT="/agent/jobs/ddbdc7c3-ea00-49cb-a873-e155d8048779/provenance"

TARGETS=[("vch:VC_A0824","V. cholerae VC_A0824","only K00836 gene in vch; DAP source per PMID 19196710"),
         ("ppu:PP_2800","P. putida PP_2800","KT2440 K00836 gene 1"),
         ("ppu:PP_4223","P. putida PP_4223","KT2440 K00836 gene 2"),
         ("eco:b1748","E. coli astC (control AT)","single-domain aminotransferase control"),
         ("vch:VC_1624","V. cholerae CANSDH","the Type III dehydrogenase itself")]
rows=[]
for kid,name,note in TARGETS:
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.kegg.jp/get/{kid}", timeout=25)
    t=r.text if r.status_code==200 else ""
    m=re.search(r"AASEQ\s+(\d+)",t); orth=re.search(r"^ORTHOLOGY\s+(.*)$",t,re.M)
    nm=re.search(r"^NAME\s+(.*)$",t,re.M)
    rows.append(dict(kegg_id=kid,label=name,note=note,aa=int(m.group(1)) if m else np.nan,
                     orthology=orth.group(1).strip() if orth else "(none)",
                     name=(nm.group(1).strip()[:70] if nm else "")))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); D.to_csv(f"{OUT}/daba_fusion_check.csv", index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",75)
print(D[["kegg_id","aa","orthology","name"]].to_string(index=False))

vcf=D.loc[D.kegg_id=="vch:VC_A0824","aa"].iloc[0]
print(f"\nV. cholerae VC_A0824 = {vcf:.0f} aa")
print("single-domain DABA aminotransferase is ~420-460 aa; a DAT+DDC fusion is ~900 aa")
print("KT2440 PP_2800 = %.0f aa, PP_4223 = %.0f aa"%(D.loc[D.kegg_id=='ppu:PP_2800','aa'].iloc[0],
                                                     D.loc[D.kegg_id=='ppu:PP_4223','aa'].iloc[0]))

P=D.dropna(subset=["aa"]).sort_values("aa")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5,4.6))
col=["#3A6EA5" if a>700 else "#B03030" if "PP_" in k else "#888" for a,k in zip(P.aa,P.kegg_id)]
ax.barh(P.label, P.aa, color=col)
ax.axvline(700, color="k", ls="--", lw=1.4)
ax.text(710, 0.15, "a DABA-AT + DABA-DC fusion\nwould fall to the right", fontsize=9)
for i,a in enumerate(P.aa): ax.text(a+10, i, f"{int(a)} aa", va="center", fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_xlabel("protein length (aa)", fontsize=11)
ax.set_title("Does KT2440 hide a 1,3-diaminopropane source in a K00836 gene?\n"
             "V. cholerae runs the diaminopropane pathway (PMID 19196710) yet KEGG shows no K13745 in it, so K13745 absence alone proves nothing.\n"
             "Both KT2440 K00836 genes are single-domain aminotransferases, so the diaminobutyrate decarboxylase step is absent on length grounds.",
             fontsize=10.5, loc="left")
for sp in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
